question: In the CANTOS trial of patients with a history of heart attack and signs of pronounced inflammation, how did canakinumab work to try to prevent recurrent cardiovascular disease?
answers: By inhibiting IL-1β, an inflammatory signal (a product of caspase-1)
It blocked the inflammatory molecule IL-1β

receipt.quote: Most importantly, inhibition of the caspase-1 product IL-1 b with canakinumab exempliﬁes an anti-aging treatment applicable to patients. The phase 3 clinical trial CANTOS evaluated the capacity of canakinumab to prevent recurrent CVD in patients with a history of myocardial infarction and signs of pronounced inﬂammation.
